claim.claim-text: 1. A method for processing an audio signal for performing binaural rendering, the method comprising:

obtaining information of a vector indicating BRIR filter coefficients corresponding to each channel of the input audio signal in the BRIR filter set by selecting as BRIR filter coefficients corresponding to a specific channel, when BRIR filter coefficients having the same altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal are present in the BRIR filter set, the BRIR filter coefficients having altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal, and when BRIR filter coefficients having the same altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal are not present in the BRIR filter set, the BRIR filter coefficients having a minimum value of a geometric distance from the specific channel as BRIR filter coefficients corresponding to the specific channel, wherein the truncated subband filter coefficients of the corresponding channel are indicated by the information of the vector, wherein the geometric distance is a value obtained by aggregating an absolute value of an altitude deviation between two positions and an absolute value of an azimuth deviation between the two positions.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein a length of truncated subband filter coefficients of at least one subband is different from a length of truncated subband filter coefficients of another subband.
3. An apparatus for processing an audio signal for performing binaural rendering for an input audio signal, the apparatus comprising: a parameterization unit (300) configured to:

obtain binaural room inpulse response, BRIR, subbandd filter coefficients by converting BRIR filter coefficients from a BRIR filter set generate truncated subband filter coefficients for filtering a direct sound and an early reflections sound of the input audio signal, wherein the truncated subband filter coefficients are obtained by truncating, in each subband, the binaural room impulse response, BRIR, subband filter coefficients for binaural filtering the input audio signal according to a length of the truncated subband filter coefficients, wherein the length of the truncated subband filter coefficients is determined in each subband based on a filter order obtained by average reverberation time information of subband extracted from the corresponding BRIR subband filter coefficients, and a binaural rendering unit (220) configured to: receive the input audio signal including a multi-channel signal; obtain the truncated subband filter coefficients from the parameterization unit (300); filter each subband signal of the input audio signal by using the truncated subband filter coefficients of a corresponding channel and subband, characterized in that the binaural rendering unit (220) is further configured to:

obtain information of a vector indicating BRIR filter coefficients corresponding to each channel of the input audio signal in the BRIR filter set by selecting as BRIR filter coefficients corresponding to a specific channel, when BRIR filter coefficients having the same altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal are present in the BRIR filter set, the BRIR filter coefficients having altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal, and when BRIR filter coefficients having the same altitude and azimuth deviations within +/- 20° from the specific channel of the input audio signal are not present in the BRIR filter set, the BRIR filter coefficients having a minimum value of a geometric distance from the specific channel, wherein the truncated subband filter coefficients of the corresponding channel are indicated by the information of the vector, wherein the geometric distance is a value obtained by aggregating an absolute value of an altitude deviation between two positions and an absolute value of an azimuth deviation between the two positions.
4. The apparatus of claim 3, wherein a length of truncated subband filter coefficients of at least one subband is different from a length of truncated subband filter coefficients of another subband.
